title: Foreword: Pre-Generation Prediction and Characterisation of LLM Test Failures using the Jacobian Lens
abstract: arXiv:2610.28187v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Testing LLM-based software is expensive: each input needs several sampled responses, each judged by a costly oracle. Further, every prompt or model change calls for re-testing. Pre-generation adequacy measures cut this cost by ranking inputs by failure risk based on the model's internal state. However, the state of the art, Clotho, models only passing reference inputs, and its hidden-state representation says nothing about why inputs fail. We present Foreword, a framework built on two ideas: learn from both passing and failing references, and represent inputs through the Jacobian lens (J-lens), an interpretability technique that reads intermediate activations out as scores over vocabulary tokens. translated_title: Foreword：基于雅可比透镜的LLM测试失败的生成前预测与表征
translated_abstract: 测试基于大语言模型（LLM）的软件成本高昂：每个输入都需要多次采样响应，且每次响应都需要由昂贵的判定器（oracle）进行评估。此外，每次提示词或模型的变更都要求重新测试。生成前的充分性度量通过基于模型内部状态对输入按失败风险进行排序，从而降低这一成本。然而，当前最先进的方法Clotho仅对通过测试的参考输入进行建模，且其隐藏状态表示无法解释输入为何失败。我们提出了Foreword，一个建立在两个核心思想之上的框架：同时从通过和失败的参考样本中学习，并通过雅可比透镜表征输入——这是一种可解释性技术，将中间激活读取为词汇标记上的分数。Foreword将这些表示与两种估计器相结合：稀疏逻辑回归探针或双高斯混合模型，后者还能提供参考密度（用于标记参考样本未覆盖的输入）以及失败类别成分……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出Foreword框架，利用雅可比透镜将LLM中间激活读取为词汇标记分数来表征输入，并结合通过与失败参考样本及稀疏逻辑回归探针或双高斯混合模型，实现测试失败的生成前预测与失败原因表征。
en_tdlr: Foreword predicts and characterizes LLM test failures before generation by representing inputs through the Jacobian lens—reading intermediate activations as vocabulary-token scores—and learning from both passing and failing references via sparse logistic-regression probes or dual GMMs.
